Hi Marta — thanks for the heads up.

We can apply the single payment to the two invoices you listed but need a formal remittance or a bank trace to reconcile in our ledger. Two quick items:
1) If you can confirm the invoice numbers to apply against (7701 / 7734) we will post them accordingly.
2) Please confirm the USD 3,800.00 VAT line: is that a VAT reimbursement/credit on your statement, or did you withhold VAT from the payment? If it was a withholding, please provide the tax certificate or withholding slip so our accounting team can process the tax credit.

If it helps, we typically apply payments in invoice-date order unless you provide an allocation. If you want us to split the payment exactly as 22,000 / 23,622.47 we will post that immediately once we receive the remittance PDF or bank reference (you already mentioned TRX987654321 — sending the bank confirmation would be enough).

I can also generate a short reconciliation spreadsheet from our side and send it back for sign-off to make sure both ledgers match. Laura — looping you in to confirm whether you'd like us to apply the VAT as a credit to the customer account or keep it as an unapplied tax hold until documentation arrives.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Finance Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
